summary: This bill expresses the sense of Congress that tariffs imposed by the Trump administration on imports from Mexico and Canada violate the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) and affirms support for the USMCA and its dispute settlement process.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly addresses tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico, arguing they violate the USMCA and undermine free and fair trade. It advocates for the elimination of non-tariff trade barriers, clearly pushing towards free trade principles.
